name: Introduction to Blockchains, Cryptocurrencies, and Smart Contracts
description: Blockchains, cryptocurrencies, and smart contracts; core ingredients of blockchains (P2P networking and cryptographic primitives); the Bitcoin blockchain structure; consensus protocols; mining strategies and attacks; anonymity and traceability; and scalability solutions, including sharding, segregated witness, and the lightning network; Ethereum, smart contracts, and “blockchain as a service” along with emerging applications across finance, identity, supply chains, and public infrastructure.
